title: Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, a familiar spiritual energy fluctuation quietly penetrated the barrier—that was Ling Yuan's unique mark. A jade slip silently fell into his palm, containing only four words: 'Zi Shi, Dragon Vein.'

text.content: Ye Qing's figure swept into the room like a specter, carrying a chill demonic aura. Today she wore a dark combat outfit, showing less of her usual bewitching charm and more urgency and gravity. In the flickering candlelight, her heterochromatic pupils reflected Chen Ji's composed face: 'Young Master Chen, the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor has arrived at the Holy Sect's Mountain Gate. He submitted a visiting card three days ago.' She paused, lowering her voice, 'He specifically requested to see the Holy Lord, and the terms he proposed—'

dialogue.content: 'Jointly develop the East Sea Dragon Vein.' Ye Qing's tone carried a hint of mockery, 'What an ambitious offer. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor speaks on behalf of the Son of Heaven, opening with a proposal to share equally with our Holy Sect—hm, anyone with eyes can see, what does the East Sea Dragon Vein have to do with our Holy Sect? He's merely using this as an excuse.' She raised her eyes to look directly at Chen Ji, 'Young sir, I always feel this old fox has ulterior motives.'

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back by the window, the moonlight outlining his lean profile. He didn't answer immediately; instead, he closed his eyes to regulate his breathing, his fingertips subtly touching the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul flickered slightly, as if reminding him of something. Heavenly Fate Value—his remaining reserve, like a flickering oil lamp, each glimpse of heavenly secrets consuming his already fragile fate trajectory.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor personally visits the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—this matter certainly holds secrets. How do you choose to obtain intelligence?

choices.text: Expend Heavenly Fate Value to divine
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to directly peer into the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's true purpose and appearance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value was scarce to begin with; expending it will make handling subsequent changes even more difficult

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sank slightly, spiritual energy surging through his fingertips. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew scalding, a familiar burning pain spreading from his Brow Center through his limbs—as if someone was tearing an opening in the river of fate. His vision began to twist, and before his eyes appeared a hazy scene of light and shadows...

choices.text: Send Ye Qing to investigate thoroughly
choices.description: Leverage Ye Qing's Saint position to gather intelligence from within the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a large amount of intelligence but may expose Ye Qing's identity
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's situation becomes more dangerous, and the intelligence may be incomplete

text.content: Ye Qing slightly inclined her head, about to turn and leave, when Chen Ji suddenly spoke: 'Saint, please wait.' His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable certainty, 'The Saint should not appear in this matter regarding the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor—I have a better way.'

The moment Heavenly Fate Value was抽取, Chen Ji felt his vision go dark, then fell into a chaotic void of light and shadows. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out from the depths of his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of urgency: 'Young one, this person's fate constellation is peculiar. This old one only glimpsed a corner—look carefully now.' The light and shadows coalesced, gradually outlining a withered yet sinister face... Chen Ji's pupils abruptly contracted.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispers) 'This face... do you recognize it? Ten years ago, at the Tianqing Sect's marriage annulment ceremony, it wasn't only your father presiding over the ritual. Someone, using the excuse of 'incompatible birth signs and offending the dragon qi,' tore up the betrothal contract between you and the Su family's daughter—their handwritten letter, the ink is still fresh. Do you think it was truly the Su family who broke off the engagement?'

text.content: Chen Ji猛地睁开眼，胸口剧烈起伏。退婚——这两个字如同一根刺，深深扎入他心底最阴暗的角落。当年他被视为废物，固然有资质低下的缘故，但那封措辞严厉的悔婚书，却是压垮他尊严的最后一根稻草。而今，太子太师……那个在退婚书上留下朱砂批注的身影，竟与眼前这位权倾朝野的老人重合为一。

dialogue.content: Ye Qing saw Chen Ji's complexion change dramatically, a flash of worry crossing her brow: 'Young sir? What did you see?' Chen Ji didn't answer; instead, he continued to question Mo Xiansheng: 'Why did he want to break up this marriage? What does it have to do with him if the Chen and Su families form an alliance?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was silent for a moment, then slowly said: 'Because of your sister—Chen Nian. She is the starting point of all this.'

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered violently. Mo Xiansheng's voice continued, carrying a hint of vicissitude: 'Chen Nian possesses a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" physique. Her bloodline can interfere with the Tianji Record's divination—back then, the Holy Sect took her away was no coincidence. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor... or rather, the people behind him, have been laying this out long ago. They needed a clean Chen Nian, unable to let her form any destined bonds with anyone. The annulment was just the first step.'

choice.prompt: Truth struck like thunder—ten years of marriage annulment humiliation was actually for today's imprisonment of Chen Nian. Chen Ji's heart felt like it was being cut by knives right now. How do you choose to respond?

choices.text: Suppress the blaze of fury, plan from the long term
choices.description: Suppress the surging hatred in his heart, use reason to plan the next move
choices.visible_reward: Preserve room for maneuver, avoid alarming the snake
choices.risk_hint: If the pent-up anger cannot be released, it may affect subsequent judgment

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes. His fingernails deeply embedded into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he didn't make a single sound. After a long while, he opened his eyes, the fire of rage in his gaze already covered by a layer of ice: 'What a Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor... what a decade-long scheme.'

choices.text: Enraged beyond control, slay the messenger
choices.description: Act under the guise of a废物, launch a thunderous strike, personally kill the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's lackeys
choices.risk_hint: This move may disrupt overall deployment, and the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's strength is profound and unfathomable

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly rose, spiritual energy surging wildly, causing the window lattice to creak. The candlelight was extinguished in the violent gust, leaving only his bloodshot eyes in the darkness. Ye Qing gasped, yet was forced back several steps by a sharp killing intent—she had never seen Chen Ji so out of control. That hatred seemed ready to devour heaven and earth.

choices.text: Kill with a borrowed blade, divert the trouble eastward
choices.description: Leak the information to Han Lie, use the Xuanwu Sect to probe the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor
choices.visible_cost: Need to pay a certain price to buy Han Lie's cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Watch the tigers fight from the mountain top, reap the fisherman
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie is simple-minded, but not an easy person to manipulate

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly let out a cold laugh, a smile that sent chills down Ye Qing's back. He said softly: 'That idiot Han Lie, he always regards himself as the number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's visit, on the surface it's negotiating with the Holy Sect, but actually it's declaring to the entire cultivation world that imperial power trumps sects—if he knew, what would he do?'

However, just at this moment, a familiar spiritual energy fluctuation penetrated the layers of barriers, silently landing in Chen Ji's palm. That was Ling Yuan's unique mark—a warm jade slip, bearing four vermillion characters: 'Zi Shi, Dragon Vein.' Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, a cold smile forming in his heart: Old fox, you finally can't sit still. Ling Yuan's message came at just the right moment, as if he had long anticipated the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's arrival.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped forward to glance at the jade slip, her complexion slightly changing: 'This is Ling Yuan's mark? How does he have contact with the young sir?' Chen Ji didn't answer, pocketing the jade slip into his sleeve, and said calmly: 'Saint, I need you to help me with something—go investigate the personnel accompanying the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor, especially... whether there's a woman named 'Chen Nian.' Ye Qing shuddered all over: 'Chen Nian? The young sir's sister?'

text.content: Chen Ji turned to gaze at the dark night sky outside the window, his voice low as an abyss: 'Ten years.' His back looked exceptionally lonely in the moonlight, 'Ten years ago they broke my engagement, imprisoned my sister, and trampled me underfoot as waste—I endured ten years, schemed ten years. Now that they've come to my door...' He turned his head back, cold light suddenly flashing in his eyes, 'Then old scores and new grudges, let's settle them together.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's invitation hides profound mystery, the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's ambition is clear for all to see. How do you decide to proceed?

choices.description: Go to the appointment at the Dragon Vein at Zi Shi, to ascertain Ling Yuan's true intentions
choices.visible_cost: May fall into Ling Yuan's trap
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence from within the Tianqing Sect, and more information about the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is a deeply unfathomable person, going to the appointment carries great risk

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan's transmission echoes in Chen Ji's Mental Sea) 'Little junior-disciple, though we share the same sect, we've never truly opened our hearts to each other. This old man knows you're no ordinary person. Today the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor comes to cause trouble—why don't you and I... join forces? Zi Shi, at the entrance to the East Sea Dragon Vein, this old man awaits you.'

choices.text: Secretly track the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's demonic fog to conceal aura, lie in ambush by the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's side
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain first-hand intelligence on the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor and Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will directly confront the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor

text.content: Ye Qing pondered for a moment, then pointed at Chen Ji's Brow Center, a wisp of blue mist seeping into his spiritual consciousness: 'Demonic fog can conceal the young sir's aura for half an hour, but remember—don't take the initiative to provoke that old fox.' She paused, a hint of worry flickering in her eyes, 'Young sir, are you truly going to personally risk danger?'

choices.text: Take the initiative to reveal oneself and make a clean break
choices.description: Request an audience with the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor in the identity of a Tianqing Sect Menial Servant, directly probe
choices.visible_reward: May directly see Chen Nian, and cause the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor to lose his composure
choices.risk_hint: May be directly seen through the disguise by the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor

text.content: Ye Qing sucked in a breath of cold air: 'Young sir, have you gone mad? The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's cultivation is peerless—if you show your true face—' Chen Ji laughed instead, that smile carrying a hint of sarcasm: 'Waste? Heh, in his eyes, I'm merely an ant he can crush with a flick. It's precisely because of this that he won't bother looking twice at a mere Menial Servant Disciple.'

Outside the window came a sudden dull horn call—that was the ceremonial music of the Holy Sect welcoming honored guests. Ye Qing's expression changed: 'The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's convoy has arrived. Young sir, time is running out.' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze passing through the numerous halls and palaces, as if he could see in that grand convoy a gaunt figure in imperial robes slowly approaching. Ten years ago he stood in the Chen family ancestral hall, watching this person personally slap the annulment letter onto his face; ten years later, he would meet this person again in a completely different posture.

Just at this moment, the jade slip in Chen Ji's sleeve grew warm again. He took it out to look, only to see beneath the original four characters, a new line of text had quietly appeared—'Chen Nian is in the third carriage.' Ling Yuan's calligraphy was robust and archaic, each character seemingly carved into his heart. Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, his knuckles white. Ten years—he finally knew his sister's whereabouts. But he couldn't be impulsive, couldn't be rash—Ling Yuan's 'kindness' must have scheming behind it. He coldly smiled in his heart: Old fox, you think I'll乖乖 enter your game?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to Ye Qing: 'Saint, the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's visit, on the surface about the Dragon Vein, actually intends to pressure our Holy Sect. Among the people he brought, there exists a special presence—Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' A hint of understanding flashed in Ye Qing's eyes: 'So that's why he dares to make such enormous demands?' Chen Ji nodded, his voice ice-cold: 'I already know his trump card. The next chess game, it's my turn to make a move.'

text.content: Night deepened, the Holy Sect's Mountain Gate lit up brightly. In the distance came the ceremonial official reading the visiting card, solemn and dignified. Chen Ji stood in the shadows, watching the grand convoy slowly enter the Mountain Gate, yet his heart was like cold ice. Three carriages, the fourth... Ling Yuan's intelligence couldn't be wrong. Chen Nian was right there. For ten years he had dreamed countless times of his sister's face; now she was just a stone's throw away. He closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions in his chest. Wait a little longer, wait for the best moment—he wanted a single decisive strike, to make those people pay ten times the price.

In the distance, Chen Ji saw an elderly figure in dark imperial robes slowly descend from the carriage. His build was gaunt, his features weathered, his narrowed triangular eyes with hidden gleams of sharpness, his whole body's aura restrained yet suffocating—the very Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor, the chief strategist behind the annulment ceremony ten years ago. Chen Ji's gaze locked死死 on that face, his fingernails deeply embedded in his palms. Blood dripped, he was entirely unaware. 'Someday,' he silently vowed in his heart, 'I will make you kneel before the spirits of the Chen ancestors and, for everything you've done... kowtow and beg for forgiveness.'

Just at this moment, a familiar spiritual energy fluctuation quietly penetrated the barrier—that was Ling Yuan's unique mark. A jade slip silently fell into Chen Ji's palm, containing only four characters: 'Zi Shi, Dragon Vein.' Ye Qing stepped forward to glance at the jade slip, her complexion slightly changing: 'This is Ling Yuan's mark? How does he have contact with the young sir?' Chen Ji didn't answer, pocketing the jade slip into his sleeve, cold light flashing in his eyes. Old fox, you finally can't sit still. Ling Yuan's message came at just the right moment, as if he had long anticipated the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's arrival.
